title: OfferCancel
key_points: The OfferCancel transaction is used to cancel a previously submitted offer.
It requires the trust account to have sufficient XRP or other assets to cover any pending transactions associated with the offer.
The offer ID must be specified in the transaction.
If the canceled offer had any associated escrow holds, they are also released as part of this process.
limitations: Limited context provided about real-world usage and implications of OfferCancel
Focuses on technical details rather than broader system impact or potential edge cases
asserts: The OfferCancel transaction allows a user to cancel an offer they previously submitted, releasing any associated escrow holds in the process.
scope: Describes how OfferCancel can be used by parties who have previously submitted offers to revoke them and release related escrow holdings on the XRP Ledger.
